title: Split cancellation above the residue homology bound
statement: Let S be affine and B a cochain complex of quasi-coherent finitely presented modules flat over id_S, supported in [0,b] for b∈ℕ. If its residue-field pullback homology vanishes in every natural degree q>d, then there exists D supported in [0,d], still termwise flat, quasi-coherent and finitely presented, with a chain homotopy equivalence D ≃ B. Pseudo-coherence and pullback homology comparisons are not conclusions of this cancellation lemma.

source.place: Tags 068V and 08EB; bounded finite-projective specialization with explicit split cancellation

proof.text: Use the affine tilde/global-sections equivalence and the affine finite-presentation sections criterion to identify every section module of B as finitely presented; the terms are flat by the identity-IsFlatOver specialization, so Module.Flat.projective_of_finitePresentation makes them finite projective. Residue pullback is tensor with the residue field.

At a top degree m>d the cokernel of the preceding differential is finite with zero fibres. Local Nakayama (Mathlib.RingTheory.Nakayama) makes each localization zero, and Module.eq_zero_of_localization_maximal detects that the finite module itself is zero. The surjection onto the finite projective top term splits by Projective.factorThru (equivalently Finite.exists_comp_eq_id_of_projective). Its kernel is a finite projective direct summand, using Retract.projective and finite generation. The removed identity pair is contractible, giving a homotopy equivalence. Descending induction stops at d; m-1 ≥ 0 preserves the lower bound. Transport the resulting complex and homotopies back by associated sheaves. The b≤d and zero-ring cases give identity and zero models.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_finitePresentation_flat_shortening_construction (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : IsAffine S) (B : CochainComplex S.Modules ℤ) (b d : ℕ)
    (hBge : B.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hBle : B.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hBflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (B.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 S))
    (hBqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (B.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hBfp : ∀ n : ℤ, (B.X n).IsFinitePresentation)
    (hvan : ∀ (s : S) (q : ℕ), d < q →
      IsZero ((((Modules.pullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj
        B).homology q)) :
    ∃ D : CochainComplex S.Modules ℤ,
      D.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ D.IsStrictlyLE d ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (D.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 S)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (D.X n).IsQuasicoherent) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (D.X n).IsFinitePresentation) ∧
      Nonempty (HomotopyEquiv D B)
